content: Pydantic v2 (current stable 2.13.x) carries 2-3x instantiation overhead vs dataclasses/attrs due to its Rust-core validation engine, and higher memory footprint (even with slots=True, though slots recovers ~40% of that overhead). attrs and stdlib dataclasses(slots=True) are fastest for pure internal value objects with no validation need. Guidance: use Pydantic v2 at trust boundaries (the public structured availability contract crossing into consumer code, since validation + JSON schema + serialization matter there); use frozen dataclasses(slots=True) for internal-only value objects (Slot, internal Hold state) where validation is already guaranteed by construction and performance/simplicity matters more.
